[SWS_DM_02017] Reporting authentication required to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a diagnostic service request is not having the required authentication which results
in a negative response with NRC 0x34 (authenticationRequired), the DM shall report
a security event SEV_UDS_AUTHENTICATION_NEEDED to IdsM (see [26] and table
